Run `2026-10-09-2503d598…` (click `ad1e8839`, this morning) was refused early, before it did any work, so it says little about the model. Here it is on your three axes.

- **What it did:** it passed agent readiness and the code-state check, then stopped at the click budget check ("budget exhausted"). Nothing was selected and no agent was dispatched. The terminal outcome is `:incomplete`.
- **Lean model:** the check returned "ALERT FOR JOE".
  - **Q7 is violated:** 6 typed path absences. Every part of the path the model requires is missing from the record because the run never reached it.
  - **Q1–Q6 and Q8–Q10 are unverifiable:** the run recorded nothing about candidate enumeration, policies, cascades, G or preferences. The machine still saw the work available: 694 open tasks and 1,436 patterns in the pool.
  - Loop nodes R6, R13, R14 and CTAU-CLASS each say they were not exercised, each with its own reason. For example, R6 says `candidate-space-not-retained`.
  - The verdict is saved next to the run record as `.requirements.edn`.
- **Tokens:** none, because no jobs were dispatched (`:no-wm-jobs-dispatched`).
- **Timing:** 20.5 s wall clock. Agent readiness took 12 ms and code state 136 ms; the remaining ~11.8 s was opportunity setup before the budget refusal. The debugger never stopped it (0 ms held).

It's a refused run, so the alert is expected; this one shows the Lean check pipeline works on today's records.

**Click 48** is the real test: it's in `author-wait`, with zai-1 writing. Selection succeeded in 54 s and every phase so far ended OK. I'm watching it live and will give you the same summary when it ends, or debug at the first error.
